column1: # Common Voice locales to pull, one per pool entry.
# hours. 100 of the 119 language entries have a locale. The 19 that do not are
# **The constraint is speakers, not hours.** An entry needs 4 clips of about 8
# voiced seconds, which is maybe 40 utterances, and even 0.3 validated hours is
# roughly 200 prompts. What a thin locale cannot give is *different voices*:
# four clips cut from two speakers is a tell a regular player would learn.
#   plenty     50+ speakers, take what you need
#   workable   20 to 49, fine with care over which speakers are used
#   thin       5 to 19, expect to reuse voices, consider another source
# Pull small. 40 utterances per locale is ample and tens of GB is waste.
